segments.he: רַבִּי דּוֹסָא אוֹמֵר הָעוֹבֵר לִפְנֵי הַתֵּיבָה כּוּ׳.
segments.en: The mishna cited Rabbi Dosa’s version of the Rosh HaShana prayer: «Rabbi Dosa says: He who passes before the ark» and leads the congregation in prayer on the first day of the festival of Rosh HaShana says: Strengthen us, O Lord our God, on this day of the New Moon, whether it is today or tomorrow.
